title: Humble Oil option and a proposed amendment
shortTitle: Humble Oil option and a proposed amendment
summary: An option holder purports to exercise an option while proposing an added utility obligation, then sends an unqualified exercise before the option expires.
notes: How does an option affect the consequences of a counteroffer or outright rejection? Compare a consideration-supported option with an Article 2 firm offer. In the output variant, consider the offeror’s intervening commitment after rejection. The page’s reference to § 37 identifies the issue without supplying the full provision.
